item.title: WHS soccer teams romp past DeSoto
item.description: The Waxahachie Lady Indians bounced back from last week’s district-opening loss against Duncanville in a big way last Thursday night, cruising to an 8-0 road rout of DeSoto in a game that was moved up a day due to incoming winter weather.

item.title: WHS’ Venable to leave for college ranks at year’s end
item.description: In what will be their final season under longtime head coach Jason Venable, the Waxahachie Lady Indians extended their district unbeaten streak to four matches on Tuesday night as they routed Dallas Skyline, 8-1, at Lumpkins Stadium.
